question: Find the full names of members who have an average expense cost greater than $50 and are among the top three highest total spenders. Include only those who attended at least one 'Meeting' event held in 2020.

prediction.sql:
WITH member_expenses AS (
  SELECT
    m.XCL_034 AS member_id,
    m.XCL_035 AS first_name,
    m.XCL_036 AS last_name,
    AVG(e.XCL_020) AS avg_cost,
    SUM(e.XCL_020) AS total_spend
  FROM member AS m
  INNER JOIN expense AS e ON m.XCL_034 = e.XCL_022
  GROUP BY m.XCL_034, m.XCL_035, m.XCL_036
  HAVING AVG(e.XCL_020) > 50
),
top_spenders AS (
  SELECT
    member_id,
    first_name,
    last_name,
    total_spend,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_spend DESC) AS rn
  FROM member_expenses
),
meeting_2020_members AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.XCL_002 AS member_id
  FROM attendance AS a
  INNER JOIN event AS ev ON a.XCL_001 = ev.XCL_010
  WHERE ev.XCL_013 = 'Meeting'
    AND SUBSTRING(ev.XCL_012, 1, 4) = '2020'
)
SELECT ts.first_name, ts.last_name
FROM top_spenders AS ts
INNER JOIN meeting_2020_members AS m2020 ON ts.member_id = m2020.member_id
WHERE ts.rn <= 3

  SELECT
    m.XCL_034 AS member_id,
    m.XCL_035 AS first_name,
    m.XCL_036 AS last_name,

WITH member_expenses AS (
  SELECT 
    m.XCL_034 AS member_id,
    m.XCL_035 AS first_name,
    m.XCL_036 AS last_name,
    AVG(e.XCL_020) AS avg_cost,
    SUM(e.XCL_020) AS total_spend
  FROM member m
  INNER JOIN expense e ON m.XCL_034 = e.XCL_022
  GROUP BY m.XCL_034, m.XCL_035, m.XCL_036
  HAVING AVG(e.XCL_020) > 50
),
top_spenders AS (
  SELECT member_id, first_name, last_name, total_spend,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_spend DESC) AS rn
  FROM member_expenses
),
